text:
maya: quick kickoff for cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). need owners for pricing JSON, assets, infra creds, and legal sign-off. 10am PT sync tomorrow.

sam: I9ll take pricing JSON + trial SKU. proposing 14d default trial and a dev-stack bundle SKU.

kai: I9ll handle registry pushes + staging creds. need publisher account IDs and IAM role names.

jurgen: legal: marketplace addendum + EULA localized; DPA if PII. expect 3-5 business days review.

natalie: packaging: list two entitlements (hosted vs dedicated). designers will supply hero + icon set.

deploy-bot: created MP-2280 (assets) and MP-2281 (pricing).

maya: preflight checklist (copy/paste):
- legal: addendum, EULA, DPA if needed
- billing: pricing JSON, trial SKU, meters
- assets: logos (SVG/PNG), hero 1200x600, thumbnails
- images: docker tags, registry access
- infra: publisher IDs, IAM roles, staging creds
- QA: purchase/trial activation/cancel tests

sam: timeline?

maya: soft target = 3 weeks assuming legal clears.

kai: private-offer flow needed for AWS/Azure?

sam: yes, include private-offer opt-in field in the PR.

maya: action items: sam (pricing, 48h), kai (creds, 48h), jurgen (addendum template, 72h), natalie (assets + quickstart stub, 72h). react :thumbsup: when claimed.
